steps.text:
I've built the station bug and handed it in. It validates with no errors or warnings and passes all of NoaCG's own checks. I went through every coverage frame (Take, Update, Out, long text, empty show) on both dark and light backgrounds and didn't need to change anything.

**How it looks:** a small rounded bar in the top-right corner, inside the safe area. The channel name is in bold capitals, and under it the show title, led by a small amber "NOW" tag. The logo sits at the right end of the bar.

**Keeping your logo visible:** the logo never sits straight on the picture. It goes on a pale, nearly white disc with an amber ring and a soft glow around it, so a navy and black roundel is always on a light background whatever the footage underneath. You haven't sent me the real logo, so I tested with a stand-in navy and black roundel over a dark, busy night scene, and it stood out clearly. The bar itself has a thin light edge so its outline holds on dark video too.

**What the operator sees:** three inputs, plus the usual Take, Update and Out buttons, and no extra buttons:
